AmerisourceBergen (now officially named [Cencora](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Cencora)) is a major global healthcare company that distributes brand-name and generic prescription drugs, over-the-counter (OTC) products, specialty pharmaceuticals, and vaccines rather than manufacturing consumer-facing goods directly. [](https://www.amerisourcebergen.com/provider-solutions/hospitals-and-health-systems/purchasing-optimization)

- **Brand-Name & Generic Drugs:** Comprehensive wholesale supply of daily prescription medications for retail and hospital pharmacies.

- **Specialty & Oncology Products:** Complex therapies including oncology treatments, blood plasma derivatives, biosimilars, nephrology medications, and women's health products.

- **Vaccines:** Distribution and cold-chain management for community and clinical immunizations

[](https://www.amerisourcebergen.com/provider-solutions/hospitals-and-health-systems/purchasing-optimization)

### Front-of-Store & Over-the-Counter (OTC) Items

- **Pain Relief & First Aid:** Analgesics, aspirin, and basic wound care supplies.

- **Cold & Allergy:** Cough, cold, sinus, and allergy medications.

- **Vitamins & Supplements:** Dietary and nutritional supplements.

- **Digestive & Eye/Ear Care:** Stomach relief, antacids, and localized drops. [](https://www.amerisourcebergen.com/provider-solutions/smartsource-otc-expansion)

AmerisourceBergen (now officially named
Cencora
) is a primary global healthcare distributor rather than an independent drug manufacturer. It does not produce traditional consumer product brands. Instead, it operates specialized business units, purchasing networks, and partners with
hundreds of leading pharmaceutical manufacturers
to source and distribute branded, generic, and specialty medical products.
AmerisourceBergen
Specialized Units & Programs
ASD Healthcare
: Distributes specialty oncology, blood plasma, and nephrology products.
Besse Medical
: Focuses on community physician practices, distributing vaccines and biologics.
Oncology Supply
: Specializes in chemotherapy and immunotherapy drugs for oncology providers.
PRxO Generics & SmartSource
: Proprietary generic sourcing and purchasing programs for retail and community pharmacies.
ION Solutions & IPN Solutions
: Group purchasing organizations (GPOs) supporting oncology and specialty practices.
